strategy.text:
(1) ATTACK? Pelipper likely Scald (rain-boosted, 30% burn) or Hurricane (100% in rain); both neutral on Weezing-Galar but hit 58-75%, 2HKO range. U-turn possible.

(2) SWITCH? Possible U-turn to a rain abuser, but not the central read.

(3) THEIR READ OF ME: only seen Weezing-Galar's missed Strange Steam; knows nothing of my team.

(4) MY OPTIONS & COST OF SWITCHING: Staying in gets Weezing-Galar 2HKO'd (takes 58-75%) while only 2HKOing Pelipper (45-54% per Sludge Bomb) — a losing trade. Rotom-Heat is OHKO'd by rain Scald (99-118%). Toxtricity (Electric/Poison) resists Hurricane (27-32%), is neutral to Scald (59-70%, survives), and its Wild Charge is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper (203-239%). Burn from Scald (30%) would halve Wild Charge to ~101-119%, still a KO. This switch gains a near-certain kill on the rain setter (or forces it out) at the cost of one neutral/weak hit — a strong momentum play. I'm not behind; this is a steadier, higher-value line than staying in.

(5) MOST LIKELY ACTION + RESPONSE: Pelipper Scalds (rain-boosted), Toxtricity survives at ~30-41%; next turn Wild Charge OHKOs Pelipper. Falsifier: if Pelipper U-turns out, I still keep Toxtricity healthy (~92%) to threaten the incoming mon.

(6) SEQUENCE: I switch Toxtricity (eats Scald/Hurricane/U-turn); next turn Wild Charge OHKOs Pelipper (or the incoming mon if they pivoted).

(1) ATTACK? — Pelipper (Drizzle confirmed by rain) most likely clicks Scald (STAB in rain) or U-turn (it's a classic pivot/rain setter) or Hurricane (100% acc in rain). (2) SWITCH? — likely stays in to abuse rain, though U-turn is very possible since it's freshly in and can pivot. (3) THEIR READ OF ME — knows Weezing-Galar (Poison/Fairy, Levitate, Black Sludge) revealed, and that I missed Strange Steam. Has not seen my bench. (4) MY OPTIONS & COST — Rotom-Heat (Scarf Thunderbolt OHKOs, but eats Scald 99-118%/Hydro Pump 137-162% on switch-in = possible/guaranteed KO, too risky). Noivern resists Water, survives everything (Scald 24-29%, Hydro Pump 34-40%, Hurricane 45-53%, U-turn 5-6%), is fast (345), and Frisk reveals item for free — steady, info-gaining pivot. Toxtricity survives but Hydro Pump leaves it 4-19% and its only Electric move is physical Wild Charge on 244 Atk — less clean. Staying in only chips (45-54%) while Weezing eats 58-75%. (5) MOST LIKELY + RESPONSE — Pelipper clicks Scald/U-turn; Noivern switch tanks both and reveals item. Falsifier: if Pelipper reveals a surprise Electric/other coverage that dents Noivern hard. (6) SEQUENCE — I switch Noivern (eats hit, Frisk logs item), next turn Noivern (345 spe) outspeeds and can Draco Meteor/Hurricane or U-turn pivot.
